$schemaNote: DESIGN / CONFIG EXAMPLE ONLY. The current runtime (src/client-profile.js, src/oauth.js) does NOT read this file. Encoding this JSON does not change any behavior. See docs/OPEN-SOURCE/CLIENT-PROFILES.md.

resultEncoding.note: ChatGPT prefers both structuredContent and the same JSON in the text block. src/client-profile.js can derive structuredContent from a single JSON text block, or preserve an existing one.

annotationsDefault.note: DESIGN TARGET, NOT IMPLEMENTED. src/client-profile.js currently keeps annotations identical across profiles; ChatGPT treats tools without readOnlyHint as write actions requiring confirmation. Set explicit hints via sanitizeTool when this profile is adopted.

oauth.flow: OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256 mandatory, DCR or CIMD or pre-registered client

callbackAllowlist.note: Matches isAllowedRedirectUri() in src/oauth.js: stable callback exactly, or prefix + non-empty callback id of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. No other host or path shape is accepted.

constraints: offline_access required or access is lost on expiry.
RFC 9207 issuer identification: server advertises authorization_response_iss_parameter_supported=true and appends iss to every authorization response.
DCR in LOCKED mode needs the narrow carve-out below; it is not enabled by default.

dcr.note: src/oauth.js has isChatgptClientRegistration(): in LOCKED mode, DCR is rejected unless ALLOW_DCR_FOR_CHATGPT is set AND every redirect is a documented ChatGPT callback AND metadata identifies an OpenAI client. Use a separate switch/profile name; do not widen the Gemini pre-registered client or its secret. No code change is made here.

toolSurface.naming: server__tool (keep canonical name; do not rename per client)
toolSurface.schema: Undocumented token/volume caps reported by community (e.g. <5000 tokens, 2.43MB) - unverified; our 3 tools are small.

knownLimitations: Full MCP is plan-gated: Business/Enterprise/Edu; Pro is read/fetch only; Free/Go not supported. Web only, not mobile; admins/owners publish connectors.
No static API key / bearer header field in the ChatGPT UI - OAuth, no auth, or per-tool mixed schemes only.
Security review may reject tool text that suggests arbitrary code execution - 'execute(code)' name/description is a real risk.
Tools without readOnlyHint are treated as write actions needing confirmation.
unverified: All ChatGPT behavior above is from first-party docs / community reports as surveyed in docs/OPEN-SOURCE/WEB-CLIENTS.md (grabbed 2026-11-23); no live end-to-end connection against this gateway has been performed.
Schema token/volume limits are not vendor-documented - reproduce before treating as requirements.
